# comlaude Provider

Interact with the Com Laude corporate registrar API. Authentication uses `POST /api_login`, which requires three credentials and a service user with the "web login" property enabled.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    comlaude = {
      source = "TekaidoSecurity/comlaude"
    }
  }
}

# Credentials are usually supplied via the environment:
#   COMLAUDE_USERNAME, COMLAUDE_PASSWORD, COMLAUDE_API_KEY
# and optionally COMLAUDE_GROUP_ID. The service user must have the
# "web login" property enabled and an API key created.
provider "comlaude" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) Com Laude API key (the third `/api_login` credential). Falls back to `COMLAUDE_API_KEY`.
- `base_url` (String) API base URL. Falls back to `COMLAUDE_BASE_URL`, then `https://api.comlaude.com`.
- `group_id` (String) Default group (tenant) every resource is scoped under. Falls back to `COMLAUDE_GROUP_ID`, then to the authenticated user's own group. Individual resources may override it.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) Com Laude password. Falls back to `COMLAUDE_PASSWORD`.
- `username` (String, Sensitive) Com Laude username (login email). Falls back to `COMLAUDE_USERNAME`.
